Non-unique fields get an _id tie-breaker in the same direction, so the order is deterministic for unchanged data (equal values never swap between pages); string sorting is binary (byte order, uppercase before lowercase); last_login_at may be null — nulls sort first ascending. Filtering: filter=field:value, repeatable; different fields are ANDed, the same field twice is rejected (DUPLICATE_FILTER_FIELD), max 10 filters; filterable fields: role (user|admin|moderator), is_active, is_verified, is_premium (strictly true|false), employment.status (employed|unemployed|student|retired|freelancer), settings.theme (light|dark|system), settings.language (2 lowercase letters), address.country (exact match, 1-64 characters). description.content:
Negative case (11 filters). Expected: **400 TOO_MANY_FILTERS**.

Returns one page of users plus exact total metadata. No authentication required. Defaults apply only when a parameter is ABSENT: a present-but-empty value (?sort=, ?filter=, ?search=, ?limit=) is rejected with 400. Validation order (first error wins): page → limit → per_page → sort → filter → search. Pagination: page 1-1000000; limit 1-100 (values above 100 are clamped to 100, per_page is a legacy alias — limit wins when both are given); a page beyond the last one returns 200 with an empty users array (no error). Sorting: sort=field[:asc|desc], default created_at:desc; sortable fields: created_at, updated_at, login_count, last_login_at, username, email. Non-unique fields get an _id tie-breaker in the same direction, so the order is deterministic for unchanged data (equal values never swap between pages); string sorting is binary (byte order, uppercase before lowercase); last_login_at may be null — nulls sort first ascending. Filtering: filter=field:value, repeatable; different fields are ANDed, the same field twice is rejected (DUPLICATE_FILTER_FIELD), max 10 filters; filterable fields: role (user|admin|moderator), is_active, is_verified, is_premium (strictly true|false), employment.status (employed|unemployed|student|retired|freelancer), settings.theme (light|dark|system), settings.language (2 lowercase letters), address.country (exact match, 1-64 characters). Only whitelisted fields and typed values ever reach the database — the input cannot inject query operators. Search: search=<1-64 characters>, case-insensitive substring over username, email, profile.first_name and profile.last_name; regex metacharacters are escaped (search=.* matches literal ".*"); combined with filters by AND; not index-backed. Response headers: X-Total-Count (exact number of matches before pagination — the same value as total in the body) and Link (RFC 8288: rel="first", "prev", "next", "last"; prev/next only when they exist; every link keeps your sort/filter/search parameters and canonicalises per_page to limit). total is exact (CountDocuments) but a best-effort snapshot: the count and the page are two operations, so concurrent creates or TTL deletes may shift them slightly.
Page number (1-1000000)
Page size 1-100; values above 100 are clamped to 100
Legacy alias of limit (limit wins when both are given)
field[:asc|desc]. Fields: created_at, updated_at, login_count, last_login_at, username, email
